note: Limits for cut craft, measured as library percentiles over 205 published brand and product films (cut times and beats only, no footage kept). A check applies only to films with at least min_cuts cuts.

no_burst.why: a run of more than 8 shots in a row under 0.6 s is a burst; library p95. Hold the shots or cut fewer; a burst belongs at the end of a film, not its middle

hold_floor.why: more than 38% of shots under 0.6 s; library p90

cut_every_beat.why: more than 6 cuts in a row exactly one beat apart (library p95): skip beats and cut on the phrase. Needs --bpm
